description: This file defines a test class `TestNnModule` that extends `torch.nn.Module`. It constructs a neural network module with convolutional transpose layers, batch normalization, ReLU activations, and a Tanh output layer, suitable for generative models like GANs. The class includes an initializer setting up the sequential layers and a forward method performing the forward pass.

classes.name: TestNnModule
classes.description: A neural network module for generative modeling, with configurable parameters for input size, feature map size, and output channels.

methods.name: __init__(self, nz=6, ngf=9, nc=3)
methods.description: Initializes the neural network with a sequence of transpose convolutional layers, batch normalization, ReLU activations, and final Tanh activation.

methods.name: forward(self, input)
methods.description: Defines the forward pass of the module by applying the sequential layers to the input.
